args.title: Fix issue 4413 in src/components/Toast.tsx
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

The ToastProvider component uses a polite aria-live region for all toasts, including errors, so screen readers delay announcing errors. Also, errors are automatically dismissed after 5 seconds like other toasts. To fix, error toasts should use an assertive live region and not auto-dismiss, or stay until dismissed by the user.
